question: Does the source-code-defined bidirectional gene list recover the paper overlap, and do deposited annotation and cluster labels support exact Figure 4 correspondence?
decision: Correct the source-overlap interpretation and record annotation/cluster version gaps before using published labels to motivate an intermediate-state RQ.
strongest_rival: Using one 100-gene direction or arbitrary first 200 disease rows changes the source-list denominator; annotation releases and unverified cluster numbers can create false reproduction claims.
discriminator: Reconstruct the exact two-direction list selection specified by pinned author code and audit every deposited annotation/cluster label by age without relabeling clusters from observed effects.
exposure_record: descriptive_v1 results, the first 100-gene overlap and cluster occupancy mismatch have been seen. The author notebook was then inspected and explicitly concatenates 100 genes from each direction. This is an exposed source-audit correction.
biological_unit: Deposited mouse within each assay and tissue; slash-containing lung IDs are explicitly pooled libraries, excluded from mouse-weighted expression contrasts and composition accounting.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated tissue and assay samples and the general versus Figure 4 brain objects reuse mice/cells. IDs use different source formats. No cross-organ independence, canonical cross-assay identity resolution or external replication is asserted.
population_and_selection: All cells of the pinned Figure 4 object for annotation counts; source Table 10 old-up and young-up first 100 rows each, full disease list. No expression rerun.
contrast: Source-code-defined gene-set arithmetic and annotation-label coverage by age, without biological hypothesis testing.
endpoint: Exact union/intersection counts and per-age annotation/cluster cell and mouse-label counts.
methods: Read Table 10 second-row headers; concatenate first 100 old-up and first 100 young-up rows as in author notebook; report row and unique-gene counts against the full disease list. Export each original/reannotated cell type, free annotation, Leiden and Louvain label by age. No cluster remapping, new signatures or p-values.
missingness_and_exclusions: Missing labels retained as explicit values; no cells excluded from the annotation audit. Source gene lists are used in deposited order.
multiplicity: No p-values, significance stars, rankings by effect or confirmatory claims. The fixed descriptive marker family and all contrasts are retained, including null/unfavorable values.
precision_basis: Show every observed mouse and descriptive means; no biological-effect margin, independent unit variance justification or confirmatory power is available.
interpretation_limit: Normalized RNA detection is not senescence, secretion, pathway activation or repair. Source UMAP, cluster occupancy and signature overlap cannot establish trajectory, a distinct intermediate state or AD treatment direction. Clonality is conditional on reconstruction and tissue sampling, not immune performance. Broad shared-age signatures have prior art. No claim promotion.
stop_rule: Stop on malformed source tables; leave unresolved cluster numbering and paper/release counts as a hold. No inference about intermediate-state identity or disease transfer.
amendment_reason: P02-only source audit after v1 exposed a 100-versus-200 list ambiguity and cluster-label concordance gap; the pinned source notebook establishes a bidirectional concatenation. Original outputs retained.
